Its Industrial Systems segment develops, manufactures and markets standard and customised electric motors, magnet technology machines (including synchronous AC servo motors), and engineering/supply of drives and automation solutions. risks.note: The surge in global crude oil prices since the West Asia conflict, exacerbated by supply disruptions, has tilted risks to inflation on the upside and growth on the downside, with financial-channel effects (safe-haven flows, higher borrowing costs) that could hinder private investment and overall economic growth.
risks.risk: Geopolitical conflict and oil-price shock (West Asia)

risks.note: Global demand for power transformers continues to be strong, driving demand for requisite raw materials exponentially; certain critical inputs may face supply constraints or become costlier, pressuring input costs.
risks.risk: Raw material supply constraints and cost inflation for transformers

risks.note: Since most domestic manufacturers are expanding transformer capacity, such expanded capacity, in the absence of sustained demand, may exacerbate price competition in the industry.
Further widening of the current account deficit and capital outflows may lead to currency depreciation, adding to inflationary pressures through higher import prices.
risks.risk: Currency depreciation and import cost pressure

risks.note: Geopolitical tensions, volatility in global financial markets, and uncertainty surrounding global trade policies could pose headwinds to growth and inflation, compounded by weather-related disruptions.

The electrical motors business faces severe headwinds of intense competition that kept prices depressed despite volume growth, adversely affecting segmental margins; the Magnet Technology Machines business similarly faces severe price competition from imported brands, hurting profitability.

The Debt Equity Ratio increased sharply (to 0.15 from 0.04, up 275%) due to higher working capital borrowings and lower operating profits, while the Interest Coverage Ratio declined (to 10.28 from 14.36) on higher borrowing cost, increasing sensitivity to credit conditions.
